findings.text: _live_worker_naming names "pid <recorded>" whenever the reading carries a pid, and record_process_liveness (reckon/crew/process_liveness.py:245) falls back to the recorded pid when placement_job_alive answers None, so a placed run whose scheduler cannot be queried is refused naming the scheduler client's pid as the worker's - the case s9 says must never happen - and tests/test_a_queued_run_launches_once.py:236 covers only a queryable live job.

live_worker_pid now returns None in the session-walk and placed arms, which silently drops the " (pid N)" clause from the lift refusal at reckon/crew/resumption.py:1451 - a user-visible behaviour change outside the two launch refusals the goal names, asserted by no test, and recorded only under the manifest's evidence_inputs.

VERDICT done_when: s9's done-when names tests/test_a_queued_run_launches_once.py; the head file carries the five whole-text cases in the plan's order (tests/test_a_queued_run_launches_once.py:193-301) and the manifest records 3 passed at base against 5 passed at head, both readable in logs/01-baseline-suite.log and logs/02-after-suite.log.
VERDICT write_paths: declared paths are reckon/crew/recovery_liveness.py, reckon/crew/dispatch_launch.py, tests/test_a_queued_run_launches_once.py plus the evidence fragment and figures directory; the diff touches exactly four of them and nothing outside.

SCORE durability: 18
JUSTIFICATION durability: tests/test_a_queued_run_launches_once.py:225 fails if the refusal is worded from the recorded pid (logs/nc1) and :201 fails if the spawn liveness read is removed (logs/nc2), so the assertions bind to the defect rather than to values the test itself supplied.

JUSTIFICATION reuse: the change extends process_liveness.py:312 LivenessReading and :339 record_process_liveness rather than re-implementing the liveness composition, and a search over reckon/crew for an existing refusal-naming helper found none.
